purpose: Define bounded unsolicited conversation-request throttling before a conversation relationship exists, with configurable policy and requester blocking.

topics.name: Pre-Conversation Request Throttle
topics.purpose: Define bounded unsolicited conversation-request throttling before a conversation relationship exists, with configurable policy and requester blocking.

semantics.scope_rule: Throttle applies to pre-conversation/request state rather than established conversation traffic unless separate policy says otherwise.
semantics.default_example: Policy may use a default such as one request per requester per week; exact deployed value is configuration, not hard-coded universal truth.
semantics.identity_rule: Throttle key resolves requester/recipient identities according to messaging identity policy.
semantics.block_rule: Recipient may block a requester; blocked request attempts do not establish conversation.
semantics.bypass_rule: Creating a new rendezvous/transport session does not reset requester throttle identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Passing throttle does not itself grant conversation acceptance or data authority.

invariants.rule: Messaging is explicit peer/group communication over governed peer transport; rendezvous, transport, conversation policy and message payload remain separate semantic layers.

hard_gates.condition: throttle key uses only transient rendezvous id

prose.summary: Define bounded unsolicited conversation-request throttling before a conversation relationship exists, with configurable policy and requester blocking.
